features.summary: Disadvantage in sunlight; detect magic plus blindness or deafness per rest
features.text: You have disadvantage on Wisdom checks when you're in direct sunlight. You also have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws when you're within 10 feet of a creature that has darkvision. You know the detect magic cantrip, which you can cast at will, and you can cast the blindness or deafness spell once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Stealth in Dim Light

effects.note: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill, and you can take the Hide action even when you're obscured by a creature, if you're within 5 feet of an allied creature. When you take the Hide action, you can move up to 10 feet without triggering the noticed condition on any creature that isn't a passive creature.
